features: DOES NOT CHANGE THE DATABASE SCHEMA AND REWRITES NO DATA — No migration: users, roles, contacts, documents and accounting stay as they were. The only addition is a backup configuration key, `backup.restore.import_group_bytes`, with its default value (8 MB): it asks nothing of whoever updates. There is no new permission: the pages follow the ones that exist. For a standard role one thing changes: the collaborator does not delete suppliers (see the suppliers entry). The ancillary charges statement is calculated when printed: a statement already printed stays as it was, one printed again has today's figures, also for transfers already recorded. The beta also reviews who can open what in some pages of the panel; the security details will be published with the stable 1.11.0, in the repository's security advisories. Changes of behaviour come first. After the update, reload the pages you already have open: the reason is at the end.

CHANGES: THE PASSWORD IS RETYPED IN A WINDOW ON THE SAME PAGE — The actions that ask you to retype your password (the «Sicurezza 2FA» (2FA security) page and its commands, downloading a backup, the backup password, the mail settings, giving powers to an account) ask for it in a window over the page, not on a separate page. What you wrote in the form stays there, and after you confirm, the save restarts by itself with the same data. With «Annulla» (cancel) or Esc the action is not carried out and the form stays as it is. If you leave the page while the window is open, with the browser's back button or by opening another page, the window closes and the action does not restart. A wrong password is reported under the field and the window stays open; too many attempts say how many minutes to wait; if the session has ended the window says to reload the page and, if needed, sign in again. The «Sicurezza 2FA» page, opened from a link, opens after the confirmation; if you cancel the window while turning on 2FA, the activation window closes too, and when you reopen it the call restarts. Downloading a backup first asks for the state of the confirmation: with the password already retyped the file starts, without it the window opens and the file starts after you confirm; a click with Ctrl or Shift, or without JavaScript, goes to the server as before. When the password is asked for, and for what, does not change: the 15 minutes stay.

CHANGES: SUPPLIERS FOLLOW THE PERMISSIONS OF THE CONTACTS — Suppliers (list, record, contact persons, documents, debt position) are viewed with «Visualizza anagrafiche» (view contacts), created with «Crea anagrafiche» (create contacts), edited, with their contact persons, documents and previous debts, with «Modifica anagrafiche» (edit contacts) and deleted with «Elimina anagrafiche» (delete contacts); to open them a custom role needs these permissions. The standard collaborator reads, creates and edits suppliers and does not delete them, as for contacts, and «Elimina» (delete) does not appear to them. The supplier categories are viewed with «Visualizza anagrafiche»; a category is created with «Crea anagrafiche» or with «Modifica anagrafiche», also from the «+» of the «Crea nuovo fornitore» (create new supplier) form, and is renamed or deleted with «Modifica anagrafiche». In the supplier pages each button («Crea fornitori» (create suppliers), «Modifica dati» (edit data), «Associa» (link), «Dissocia» (unlink), «Nuova categoria» (new category), the row menu) appears only to whoever has the permission for its action; in the accounting area, the links to the supplier's record («Completa l'anagrafica» (complete the record), «Apri l'anagrafica del fornitore» (open the supplier's record), «Crea fornitore da questo file» (create supplier from this file) and the name in the F24 page) appear only to whoever has the permission of that page. The description of «Dai accesso al layout amministratore» (give access to the administrator layout) in the role page says it: suppliers ask for the permissions of the contacts, while the suppliers of invoices and payments, with their data, come from the accounting area with the panel access alone.

CHANGES: DOCUMENTS ARE MANAGED FROM THEIR OWN RECORD — From a supplier's record the edit form opens the document you chose, not the supplier's first one. The same for the documents of a unit: the edit form opens the document you chose. Of a person's documents, the list opens with «Visualizza anagrafiche»; the new form, editing, uploading and deleting ask for «Modifica anagrafiche», and the buttons appear only to whoever has the permission. A document of a supplier or of a unit is downloaded and approved from the record of the supplier or of the unit: for the supplier, downloading asks for «Visualizza anagrafiche» and approving asks for «Modifica anagrafiche» and «Approva documenti archivio» (approve archive documents); for the unit, downloading asks for «Visualizza documenti archivio» (view archive documents) and approving asks for «Approva documenti archivio». The archive «Documenti» pages, in the panel and in the portal, open, download, save, approve and delete only the documents of the archive; the transfer history takes the title of origin to the unit's record, which downloads it.

CHANGES: THE TASK INBOX — The panel's task inbox (the «Action inbox» button of the dashboard) opens with «Visualizza scadenze in agenda» (view calendar deadlines), like the deadlines box. The two icon buttons, «Rifiuta segnalazione» (reject report) and «Segna come completato» (mark as completed), ask for «Modifica scadenza in agenda» (edit calendar deadline): without that permission they do not appear, in the inbox and in the task board of the accounting area.

CHANGES: THE DROPDOWNS THAT CHOOSE PEOPLE — The «Destinatari» (recipients) dropdown of notices, deadlines and archive documents opens to whoever can create or edit that item, even only their own, and shows the people's names; «Visualizza anagrafiche» alone is neither enough nor needed. The other pages that choose or show people («Nuova segnalazione» (new report), «Crea nuovo fornitore», «Associa» of the supplier, «Crea nuovo utente» (create new user) and the user's record, the edit pages of notices, deadlines and documents, the recipients in the lists and in the dashboard) receive the data they show: the name and, where the dropdown shows it, the address. The person's record and the supplier's record, which ask for «Visualizza anagrafiche», stay complete.

CHANGES: «REINVITA» AND THE EMAIL VERIFICATION — «Reinvita» (re-invite) asks for «Modifica utenti» (edit users) and is not done on your own account or on the last active administrator: on your own row the command does not appear, and the refusal says that the password is changed in the settings, under «Password». Removing the email verification (the shield next to the name) is not done on your own account or on the last active administrator, and there the shield cannot be clicked; its title says «Utente verificato» (verified user) or «Utente non verificato» (unverified user), without inviting a click.

CHANGES: THE ANCILLARY CHARGES STATEMENT IN STORIES WITH SEVERAL TRANSFERS — (1) Ines → Sara with «Scrivi il conguaglio» (write the settlement) on 1 July, Sara → Ines with «Non scriverlo» (do not write it) on 1 September (Ines comes back), the end of Ines's lease with «Scrivi il conguaglio» on 1 December and Teo from 1 December: Teo reimburses December to Ugo, who paid with the pair (€ 30.58), and Ines reimburses Sara € 120.33; before, Teo reimbursed Sara and Ugo was left with € 30.58 that nobody gave back. The panel of Teo's start says the same. If the item has an amount already paid recorded to «l'unità (senza persona)» (the unit, no person), Sara's item, who gives back the days Ines takes back, is gross with the line «— già versato» (already paid) next to it, Ines's credit is net, like the pair in the Wallet, and the total charged to each person matches the Wallet. With two returns (after Ines → Sara on 1 July, Sara → Pia «Non scriverlo» on 1 August and Pia → Sara on 1 September; then Sara → Zoe «Scrivi» on 1 October, Zoe → Sara «Non scriverlo» on 1 November, the end of Sara's lease «Scrivi» on 1 December and Teo from 1 December) Teo reimburses Ugo and Sara reimburses Zoe € 60.16. (2) An item that starts after an agreement between the parties follows the agreement: in the example (the «Riscaldamento» (heating) from 15 October) Zoe does not reimburse Sara € 39.23 of days that the two settled between themselves. If the Sara → Zoe «Scrivi» change of 1 October was not cancelled, Zoe has all the «Riscaldamento» with the pair and Sara reimburses her November and December, € 140.77. (3) An item that starts on the day when whoever leaves, comes back and leaves again leaves for the last time, or later, takes the earlier transfers into account: Teo reimburses it to Ugo and Ines reimburses it to Sara, € 180.00; before, that amount went to the wrong person. The same after two returns (Sara reimburses Zoe € 180.00) and after an end «Scrivi», the return and a second end (Elsa reimburses Ugo € 156.77). (4) After an agreement between the parties on days that whoever had left held with the settlement of an earlier change (in the example Ines → Sara «Scrivi» on 1 July, then Sara → Zoe on 1 October with the settlement cancelled), whoever enters in the days of the return of the one who had left, and is not a party to the agreement, reimburses them their share as if the agreement did not exist: Elsa, who enters on 1 November at 20 % until 19 November, reimburses Sara € 4.51. In that case the agreement covers only the days of whoever is a party to it and ends with their exit; but if Zoe hands her days over to Elsa with «Non scriverlo», the agreement continues with Elsa: Elsa's days are settled between Elsa and Zoe, as the change panel says, and the statement does not go beyond the agreement. An agreement born from a cancelled end of lease ends when whoever had left comes back. If instead whoever had left held those days in their own instalments (the agreement with the tenant who holds the row), they stay there, and whoever enters does not reimburse them. (5) The panel of the return of whoever held the share, after the chain of the cancelled change and the written end, says that the part «l'ha presa Ugo con il conguaglio scritto alla fine locazione di Sara del 1 ottobre 2026, e Ines gliela rimborsa con il prospetto degli oneri accessori» (Ugo took it with the settlement written at the end of Sara's lease on 1 October 2026, and Ines reimburses him with the ancillary charges statement), no longer «è già nelle rate di Ines» (it is already in Ines's instalments). The note of the days after an exit that end with a second exit says from when and until when («giorni dopo l'uscita, dal 01/09/2026 al 31/10/2026»). The pairs already written in the Wallet do not change: the correction is in the statement, and it also holds for transfers already recorded.

NEW: THE CARDS IN THE USER LIST — Above the user list there are three cards: «Totale utenti» (total users), «Da verificare» (to verify: unverified email) and «Sospesi» (suspended). They count all accounts, whatever filter, page and sort order are on. A click on a card replaces the filters that are on with its own and goes back to page 1, keeping the rows per page and the sort order: «Da verificare» turns on «Verifica: Non verificati» (verification: not verified), «Sospesi» the suspended state, «Totale utenti» removes the filters. Next to «Stato» (state) there is the «Verifica» filter, with «Verificati» and «Non verificati». Opening the list with a filter in the address (a bookmark, a reloaded page), the bar shows the filters that are on and «Rimuovi filtri» (remove filters).

NEW: THE «REGISTRARE UN PASSAGGIO» GUIDE IN TABS — The guide of the «Registra passaggio» (record transfer) page is divided into six tabs on one row: «Le basi» (the basics), «Vendita» (sale), «Locazione» (lease, with the parts «Inizio» (start), «Fine» (end) and «Prospetto» (statement)), «Usufrutto» (usufruct), «Successione» (succession) and «Dopo» (afterwards). Each tab, and each part of the lease, begins with an «In breve» (in brief) box, and the special cases are in closed sections that open from the title. It opens on the tab of the type of transfer chosen in the page (with «Fine locazione», on «Locazione», part «Fine») and on the basics if there is no type; the cross-references between tabs («vedi «Vendita»») change tab. All the sentences of the earlier guide are still there; two, the ones about the statement (the agreement between the parties and the item that matures after a change of tenant), are rewritten to say what the statement does today.

FIXES: RESTORING BACKUPS — A restore step that stops without an error (memory exhausted, maximum execution time, web server limit) no longer leaves rows in the database beyond the resume point: data is written in groups of statements (up to 8 MB) confirmed together, the resume point is saved after each group, and «Riprendi il ripristino» (resume the restore) restarts from the last confirmed group, with no duplicate or lost rows. The step does not stop between the removal and the creation of a table or a view, and after an error the resume point is where the last confirmed statement ends. If the temporary folder of a backup cannot be created, the backup is marked as failed with its reason and does not stay «in progress»: the next backup, including the safety backup of «Riprendi il ripristino», starts. «Riprendi il ripristino» with the window's token answers with the same token: if the answer does not arrive, the window still has the good one, and with it resumes, unlocks («Sblocca l'applicazione») and runs the steps.

FIXES: SOME FORMS AND THE LANGUAGES — A contact with an expired identity document can be saved even when you open the edit form and save without touching anything, or change only the phone; a changed expiry date, or one written for someone who had none, must be after today, as in creation. In the «Crea nuova anagrafica» (create new contact) and «Modifica anagrafica» (edit contact) forms of the panel, the link «Vai in gestione condomini per registrarlo a sistema» (go to building management to register it) appears only to whoever has «Visualizza condomini» and «Crea condomini»; to the others a sentence says that only the buildings already registered appear here. In a supplier's debt position, the bin icon of a previous debt works; a previous debt that a past invoice settles cannot be removed, and the page says which invoice uses it. In Portuguese the interface says «utilizador» for the user in every page, and «perfil» for the role in more pages (some still say «papel»). The report of an event's payment, which was in English, is translated into Spanish and Portuguese, and the usufruct hint into Spanish.

HOW IT WORKS TODAY, WHERE IT MAKES A DIFFERENCE — (1) A browser tab opened before the update does not know the password window: until you reload it, a save that asks for the password shows the server's answer in full, in an error box, and the form stays underneath. After the update, reload the open pages. (2) In some rare stories with several transfers, what the later tenant reimburses can differ by one cent from the pair written in the Wallet: with the two returns, Teo reimburses Ugo € 30.57 against the pair's € 30.58. (3) A restore left stopped on a duplicate key before the update already has the rows of the interrupted step in the database: the fix does not unblock it. The way out is «Sblocca l'applicazione», which leaves the database half-done as it does today, and then a new restore from the beginning from the backups page, which does not open before «Sblocca l'applicazione». A backup left «in progress» by a start that failed before the update stays so for two hours from the last update of its row, then it is marked as failed. (4) After a change of tenant settled between the parties (Sara → Zoe, with the settlement cancelled), if Zoe hands her days over to Elsa with «Non scriverlo», the statement keeps the agreement afterwards too: whoever enters later in the days of Sara, who had paid, reimburses her nothing, neither when Sara comes back nor when Elsa leaves with her end of lease. In that rare story the reimbursement is calculated separately. (5) In a restore only the instant remains, a few milliseconds per group, between confirming a group and saving the resume point: a step stopped exactly there makes «Riprendi il ripristino» stop on a duplicate key.
